rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the buttocks.

example.english: I've been sitting all day, and my bum hurts.
example.traditional: 我坐咗成日，屁股都痛喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 co5 zo2 seng4 jat6 pei3 gu2 dou1 tung3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a person, usually a man, who is habitually lazy or useless.

example.english: That bum never does any work and only knows how to play video games.
example.traditional: 嗰個懶鬼成日都唔做嘢，淨係識得打機。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 laan5 gwai2 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 zou6 je5 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 daa2 gei1

rows.note: Use this vulgar noun when “bum” specifically means the anus rather than the buttocks.

example.english: I've got a sore on my bum, so I can't even sit down.
example.traditional: 我個屎窟生咗粒瘡，坐都坐唔到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 si2 fat1 saang1 zo2 nap1 cong1 co5 dou1 co5 m4 dou2
